TOMB OF QASIM BIN IMAM MUSA AL-KAZIM (A)

The shrine of al-Qasim ibn al-Kadhim (AS) in Soora'a known as the land of Jerbuaah River in the city of Hilla, and built around it a wide courtyard with large rooms for the visitors, that the shrine is a destination for visitors from different strata and languages of the Muslims.
